description: Source code for a DriveHelper struct implementing file upload functionality with command-line interface integration, including command injection, filename determination, and metadata building.

classes.name: DriveHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for drive-related operations, specifically file uploads.

methods.name: inject_commands
methods.description: Injects the '+upload' subcommand into the CLI command structure with description and arguments.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the '+upload' command execution, including filename determination, metadata creation, token acquisition, and API call to upload the file.

methods.name: determine_filename
methods.description: Determines the filename to use based on provided path and optional name argument.

methods.name: build_metadata
methods.description: Constructs JSON metadata for the file, including name and optional parent folder ID.
